case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment's caption.

number_of_accused.correct_value: Eight accused were tried; two (Sheo Shankar Singh and Umesh Singh) were the appellants before the Court.
number_of_accused.quote: Out of the remaining six accused persons, the trial court found...
number_of_accused.reason: Two is the appellant count only; the trial involved eight accused.

accused_gender.reason: Appellants are referred to in the male gender throughout.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for either accused anywhere in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Scheduled Tribe status relates to petrol pump allottee Aamlal Kisku, not the accused.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Owner of a factory (Kalyans Vyapor Brisket Udyog) per the seizure; otherwise not stated.
accused_occupation.quote: the Motor Cycle used by accused was seized from the premises of Kalyans Vyapor Brisket Udyog owned by the appellant-Sheo Shankar Singh
accused_occupation.reason: Judgment mentions factory ownership and petrol pump partnership, so 'Not stated' is incomplete.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Only pending cases are mentioned; no prior conviction record is stated.

victim_gender.reason: The deceased is referred to as male throughout.

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the deceased MLA.

victim_caste.reason: Caste of the deceased is not mentioned.

victim_religion.reason: Religion of the deceased is not mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Not stated as family or personal; adversarial, as the deceased opposed the accused's coal-mafia activities and petrol pump interests.
accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased who was perceived by the appellants as a hurdle in their activities
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment shows an adversarial relationship, not that they were strangers.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under s.302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Convictions were under s.302/34 IPC and s.27 Arms Act.

weapon.reason: Firearm (pistol/gun) used; judgment refers to gunshots and a pistol.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, circumstantial, medical and seizure/recovery evidence are all relied on.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The Court does not expressly list aggravating circumstances it accepted.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Appellants were not professional killers; no political angle to the killing; manner of killing not particularly brutal or diabolical.
mitigating_circumstances.quote: Firstly, because the appellants are not professional killers.
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court expressly reasoned mitigating points, which the extracted value wrongly says are not stated.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted and sentenced the appellants to rigorous life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court upheld conviction and enhanced sentence to death.

final_outcome.reason: Conviction upheld by the Supreme Court; sentence modified.

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder was held established beyond reasonable doubt.

imprisonment_type.reason: Rigorous imprisonment for life was the final sentence.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life imprisonment has no fixed year term; null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without outcome, e.g. the accused were tried and convicted of murder; the trial court sentenced them to life; the High Court enhanced it to death.
neutral_facts.quote: The Supreme Court upheld the conviction but commuted the death sentence to life imprisonment
neutral_facts.reason: Summary reveals the Supreme Court's outcome, which neutral facts must not do.

offence_severity.correct_value: Murder of a sitting MLA; trial sentence life imprisonment; High Court enhanced to death.
offence_severity.quote: the sentence of rigorous imprisonment for life imposed upon the said two appellants by the Trial Court enhanced to the sentence of death
offence_severity.reason: Lists sentences rather than severity; loses the murder description.

attempt_completion.reason: The deceased was killed; the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death from gunshot injuries to the head; PW16 injured in the fall.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Murder (s.302/34) for both; Arms Act s.27 conviction only for Umesh Singh. Charges under ss.120B and 201 were not part of the appellants' convictions.
number_of_offences.quote: Appellant-Umesh Singh was further charged with an offence punishable under Section 27 of the Arms Act.
number_of_offences.reason: Two counts is loose; the Arms Act count applied only to one appellant.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not expressly found; the deceased was perceived as a hurdle to the accused's activities, but no premeditation finding is made.
premeditation_planning.quote: the deceased who was perceived by the appellants as a hurdle in their activities
premeditation_planning.reason: Court notes the perception of a hurdle but does not find premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: Motive tied to opposition to coal mafia activities and the petrol pump dispute.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the Court's listed evidence and findings.

witness_credibility.reason: Matches the Court's reasoning on PW16's consistency and corroboration.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused fled the scene on the motorcycle towards Nirsa after the killing.
post_offence_conduct.quote: walked back to the motorcycle whose engine was kept running by Sheo Shankar Singh and fled towards Nirsa
post_offence_conduct.reason: Post-offence flight from the scene is stated in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 14 April 2000; trial judgment: 18 November 2003; High Court judgment: 6 May 2005; Supreme Court: 15 February 2011.
trial_duration.quote: The trial court by its judgment dated 18th November, 2003 found the appellants...
trial_duration.reason: Offence date and trial and High Court judgment dates are stated, not 'Not stated'.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellants: U.R. Lalit (senior counsel); respondents: A.T.M. Rangaramanujam and Sunil Kumar (senior counsel).
legal_representation.quote: Mr. U.R. Lalit, learned senior counsel for the appellants, Mr. A.T.M. Rangaramanujam and Mr. Sunil Kumar, learned senior counsels appearing for the respondents
legal_representation.reason: Counsel for both sides are named in the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: Investigation lapses: no TIP for PW16; blood-stained T-shirt not sent to FSL; cartridges not sent to ballistic expert; PW6 statement recorded 1.5 months later.
investigation_status.quote: the failure of the investigating agency to make a reference would not in the circumstances of the case discredit either the version of the witnesses
investigation_status.reason: Value reports court's evidentiary conclusions, not investigation status or the lapses found.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Failure to send blood-stained T-shirt to FSL and cartridges to ballistic expert; no TIP for PW16; one-and-half-month delay in recording PW6's statement.
procedural_irregularity.quote: no explanation is forthcoming for the failure of the prosecution in making a reference to the forensic science laboratory
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment expressly records investigative lapses and an unexplained omission.

appeal_history.reason: Matches trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the prosecution case on coal mafia motive and eyewitness reliance.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence challenged the TIP for PW16, the FSL and ballistic omissions, the delay in recording PW6, the FIR timing and borrowed motorcycle.
defence_argument.quote: Mr. Lalit then argued that while a test identification parade had been conducted
defence_argument.reason: Sentencing argument is not attributed to the defence; the recorded defence arguments are misstated.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Rarest of rare test and life as the rule are applied in the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Also relied on: Shivaji Genu Mohite; Hari Shanker; Kishanpal; Malkhansingh; Pramod Mandal; Aqeel Ahmad; Ram Bihari Yadav; Surendra Paswan; Amar Singh; Ranbir; Satbir Singh; Prakash Sakha Vasave.
precedent_relied_upon.quote: State of Maharashtra v. Prakash Sakha Vasave and Ors. (2009) 11 SCC 193 - relied on.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Listed cases are accurate but the list omits many precedents relied on.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Matches the four reasons given for commutation, including the trial/High Court disagreement.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Matches the reasons the Court gave against the death penalty.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court identified no aggravating factors justifying death.

other_sentence_order.reason: Only the death sentence was modified to life; no other order is stated.
